summary: Backend-only testing of iteration 11 additions (support chat + soft-delete for equipment & site access) plus full security regression. All 11 new-feature tests and all 33 existing security tests pass (44/44).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1077 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider splitting routers per module (auth, assess, loto, equipment, access, admin, support) for maintainability.

GET /api/equipment restricts to Safety Officer/Supervisor only, so workers cannot view equipment they own; DELETE by a worker owner works but they immediately have no listing to confirm — fine given current UX but worth documenting.

support_chat swallows all exceptions and always returns 200 with a fallback string. This is intentional per spec, but consider logging correlation id and returning 503 for infra-monitoring parity (non-blocking).
seed_data_creation: TestDeleteEquipment inserts throwaway docs directly into mongo `equipment` collection with fields {id, user_id, outcome, make, model, created_at, deleted_at:None} — soft-deleted by the tests themselves. TestDeleteAccess creates & soft-deletes real signin records via the API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New test file `/app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py` covers POST /api/support/chat (1 Gemini call cap), DELETE /api/equipment/{id}, DELETE /api/access/{id}, and dashboard regression. It uses the shared officer/worker seed accounts from `/app/memory/test_credentials.md`. It reads MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from /app/backend/.env for direct seeding. `test_security.py` remains the canonical regression suite (33 tests, ~50s).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no issues found. Both new delete endpoints correctly perform soft-delete (set deleted_at=<iso>) with owner-or-privileged authorisation. GET /api/access filters {deleted_at: None} on records. Support chat returns non-empty reply for auth'd users and 401 for anonymous.
